THREE STEPS, THEN BACK TO YOUR DAY

A watcher, not a game bot.

MESOS - WATCH reads the screen you share. It doesn’t click, trade, or ask for your MapleStory password.

  1. Open up shop.Keep your Sold Items list and total visible.
  2. Check the reading.Select both areas and confirm the OCR matches.
  3. Let Discord know.Two matching readings of an increased total trigger an alert.
Privacy & limitations

Game images are processed locally with Tesseract.js. The OCR library and language files load from jsDelivr and Tesseract’s language-data CDN. Your webhook is kept only in page memory and sent directly to Discord; it isn’t saved to our server or browser storage. If screenshot attachments are enabled, only the selected Sold Items crop is sent to your Discord channel. Session history clears on refresh; export it first if you want to keep it.

Screen sharing requires a desktop browser with screen capture support, such as Chrome or Edge. Hidden tabs can be slowed or suspended by the browser, so alerts may be delayed. Unreadable text, overlapping windows, scaling, or scrolling can cause missed or incorrect readings. If the total falls, monitoring pauses so you can start a new session. Item text is OCR-derived and may need verification. No ads or donation payments are active until the site owner configures them.

MESOS - WATCHAn independent fan project. Not affiliated with Nexon.Keep your shop. Keep your peace.
